authenticated: Authenticated. The environment has credentials now.
activeConflict: Another sign-in attempt is active. Finish or cancel that attempt before starting a new sign-in.
accountConflict: Another sign-in attempt is active. Finish or cancel it in its original account setup before starting this one.
cancelPreviousFailed: Could not cancel the previous sign-in. Retry before starting a new one.
activeCheckFailed: Could not check for an active login.
timedOutRetry: The login timed out. Start it again.
unfinishedRetry: The login did not finish. Start it again.
copyCodeFirst: Copy the code, then open the authentication page.
binding: Binding this agent to the signed-in account...
bound: Agent bound to the signed-in account.
bindFailed: Could not bind this agent to the signed-in account.
claudeFailed: The login did not finish. Start the login again.
claudeTimedOut: The login timed out. Start the login again.
submitBrowserCodeFailed: Could not submit the browser code.
insecureTransport: This connection is not encrypted. The login code travels in clear text on this network. Continue only on a network you trust.
savedClaudeHelp: You have a saved Claude login. Use it to bind this agent, or log in again to replace the stored token.
savedClaudeBound: The saved Claude login is bound to this agent now.
openAuthorizationThenCode: Open the authorization page, then enter the browser code it shows.
localExpired: This sign-in attempt expired. Start sign-in again.
localSubmitFailed: Could not submit the authorization code. Start sign-in again.
startBeforeCode: Start sign-in before submitting a code.
